jobs.employer_name: NaiStell Ivy Consulting AB
jobs.description:
Recruited by NaiStell Ivy Hire on behalf of our client
Location: Stockholm, Sweden
Employment type: Part-time / Full-time
Language requirements: English or Swedish
Minimum experience: 2 years in fundraising

NaiStell Ivy Hire is a recruitment partner connecting talented professionals with organisations that make a difference. We are currently recruiting on behalf of a client specialising in face-to-face and door-to-door fundraising for humanitarian, environmental and social causes.
About the Role
We are looking for passionate, experienced and motivated fundraisers to join our client's growing team in Stockholm.
As a Door-to-Door Fundraiser, you will engage with people in their homes, introduce them to important humanitarian and environmental causes, and inspire them to become monthly donors. This role suits someone who loves talking to people and is passionate about making a difference through communication. You will represent the client's partner organisations with professionalism, enthusiasm and integrity.
Responsibilities
Conduct door-to-door fundraising campaigns in designated areas
Engage the public in meaningful conversations about humanitarian, environmental and social causes
Recruit new monthly donors through face-to-face communication
Communicate the mission, values and impact of the partner organisations
Build trust and positive relationships with potential donors
Maintain high standards of donor quality, professionalism and ethical fundraising
Work towards individual and team fundraising targets
Participate in training, team meetings and ongoing coaching

Who We Are Looking For
At least 2 years of experience in fundraising
Passion for speaking with people and building relationships
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Confident communication in English or Swedish
Self-motivated, positive, persistent and goal-oriented
Enjoy working outdoors and visiting different neighbourhoods
Comfortable initiating conversations with strangers
Genuine interest in humanitarian, environmental or social causes
Reliable, professional and committed to quality results
Able to work independently and as a strong team player

How to Apply
Apply through NaiStell Ivy Hire. We will review your application and, if it's a match, introduce you to our client. Forward your CV and cover letter to hire@naistellivy.com

Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

jobs.employer_name: Engelska Skolor och Förskolor i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Would you like to spend two weeks teaching Science at a high-performing bilingual school?
Engelska Skolan Norr is looking for an engaged and responsible substitute Science teacher for Years 7-9 for a two-week period from the 11th of January to the 22nd of February, 2027.
This is a great opportunity to get to know our school, our students and our way of working. Whether you are currently looking for a teaching position, studying to become a teacher or simply interested in gaining experience in education, we would love to hear from you!
About our school
Engelska Skolan Norr is a high-performing bilingual school where strong academic results, motivated students and a collaborative staff culture create an environment where both teachers and learners thrive.
We follow the Swedish national curriculum (Lgr22) in a bilingual setting, with teaching in Science primarily conducted in English. We value high academic expectations, structured teaching and a strong focus on both subject knowledge and language development.
About the assignment
Teach Science (NO) in Years 7-9 in accordance with Lgr22.
Deliver structured and engaging lessons that maintain continuity in students' learning.
Support students with different learning needs and abilities.
Work collaboratively with colleagues and follow established plans and routines.
Contribute to a positive and focused learning environment.

We are looking for someone who:
Has a good knowledge of Science and an interest in teaching.
Is confident communicating in English and Swedish in a bilingual school environment.
Can create structure and engage students in their learning.
Is responsible, flexible and enjoys working with young people.
Values collaboration and a positive approach to education.

Teaching experience or relevant subject studies are an advantage.
Why join us?
This short-term assignment is an excellent opportunity to gain valuable classroom experience, develop your teaching skills and get to know our school and colleagues. It may also open doors to future opportunities at Engelska Skolan Norr.
Interested? Get in touch with us and tell us a little about yourself and your availability.
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan har gjort stor skillnad för elever i 30 år. Hos oss får du möjligheten att besöka världen fast på hemmaplan. Skolan har en internationell inriktning och undervisningen bedrivs både på engelska och svenska. Vi strävar efter att vara en skola där lärare kan fokusera på att undervisa, elever ges möjlighet att lära sig och där alla tycker om att komma till skolan.

Om tjänsten

Vi söker nu flexibla och engagerade lärare mot fritidshem  (grundlärarprogrammet med inriktning mot fritidshem)  till vårt team på IES Staffanstorp! 

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kan inkludera att:

- Stötta en eller flera elever i deras lärande och sociala utveckling, både i och utanför klassrummet.
- Samverka med klasslärare i årskurserna F-3.
- Planering av aktiviteter och lektioner inom vår fritidshem (Lgr22)
- Bidra till en trygg och stimulerande lärmiljö under lektioner och raster.
- Vara behjälplig vid övriga arbetsuppgifter som förekommer i skolverksamheten.
- Mentorsansvar

Vi söker dig som:

- Brinner för att arbeta med barn och ungdomar.
- Är flexibel, anpassningsbar och har lätt för att samarbeta.
- Utbildad lärare  (grundlärarprogrammet med inriktning mot fritidshem) 
- Har goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska.

Låter detta som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag och bli en del av vårt team på IES Staffanstorp! 

Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vår inspirerande och lärorika skolmiljö.

jobs.occupation: Junior Cloud RAN Layer 1 SW Developer
jobs.employer_name: Ericsson AB
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity 
  
 Are you about to graduate, or have you recently completed your university studies in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Embedded Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field? 
 Join Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 organization and help build the technology that powers next-generation mobile networks. 
 Our teams develop performance-critical software at the heart of 5G and future radio systems. As a Junior Software Engineer, you will work alongside experienced developers and technical experts to learn how advanced wireless communication systems are designed, implemented, tested, and optimized. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and excited about solving challenging technical problems in a collaborative environment. 
  
 What you will do 
  
  Develop and maintain software in Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 platform.
 Use AI-assisted engineering workflows to support activities such as developing code, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code review.
 Work with modern C++ and performance-critical software components.
 Learn how 5G/6G radio systems and physical layer processing work.
 Participate in feature development, debugging, testing, code reviews, and continuous integration activities.
 Collaborate with software developers, architects, system engineers, and testers across global teams.
 Contribute to software quality, test coverage, maintainability, and continuous improvement.
 Explore and contribute to AI/ML-enabled features that may be implemented in the product, including prototyping, integration, testing, and evaluation together with experienced engineers.
 Grow your technical skills through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience. 
  
 
 The skills you bring 
  
  Programming experience in C/C++, Python, Julia.
 Foundational understanding of AI and machine learning concepts.
 Practical experience using Python for data processing, experimentation, or machine learning through university coursework, thesis work, or personal projects.
 Experience with Linux development environments, Git, unit testing, CI/CD, or cloud-native technologies.
 Basic understanding of 5G, mobile networks, physical layer processing, or 3GPP concepts.
 Ability to use AI-assisted development tools critically and responsibly.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Interest in software engineering, high-performance systems, and telecommunications.
 Good communication skills in English.
 Curiosity, collaboration, ownership, and a strong willingness to learn. 
  
 
 You do not need previous professional telecom or Layer 1 experience. We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility, and the motivation to grow.
  
 Please send your CV in English.

jobs.employer_name: Anocca AB
jobs.description:
Join Our Team as a Process Engineer (GMP)
We are currently seeking experienced and motivated **Process Engineers (GMP)** to join our dynamic team. As a pivotal part of our operations, the Process Engineer will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficiency and effectiveness of our processes. If you have a passion for technology and a keen eye for detail, we encourage you to apply.
About the Role
As a Process Engineer, you will be involved in the manufacturing of ATMP products, to be used in clinical trials. The position is a full time permanent position with an initial probationary period of six months. Working hours in this role follow a staggered weekly schedule/shift work including weekend work.
This role at Anocca is suited to experienced and motivated professionals with a drive to lead and execute by action. Experience in aseptic work, including processing of ATMPs, as well as in electronic batch management systems would be a significant asset.
You should have high-quality relevant experience, excellent English communication skills, knowledge of aseptic manufacturing techniques, and be securely anchored in GMP regulations. You must be capable of working as part of a team but should also demonstrate initiative to drive projects forward.
What We're Looking For:
Manufacturing experience in the cell therapy or ATMP space
Previous experience in Good Manufacturing Practise (GMP)
Significant and relevant experience in cell processing equipment and validation
Good grasp of the underlying biology, preferably experience in T-cell immunology
Fluent written and spoken English

Why Join Us?
Our company is at the forefront of technological innovation, striving to make a difference in the industry. We offer a dynamic working environment where talent and ambition are recognized and rewarded. Join us, and be part of a team that values growth, collaboration, and the pursuit of excellence.
We Offer:
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
A collaborative and supportive work culture.
State-of-the-art facilities and resources.

How to Apply:
If this Process Engineer position resonates with you, we would love to hear from you. Submit your application, including your CV and a cover letter, through our careers portal. Join us in making a difference, apply now!
Recruitment may take place on an ongoing basis.

Vi söker en legitimerad lärare i svenska som andraspråk för åk 1-9 på 100% (ferietjänst). Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. 

På Internationella Engelska Skolan Skellefteå är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att trivas hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande och gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt. IES är stolta över sina medarbetare och har tagit fram en metod för att skapa en lugn och trygg skolmiljö. Detta gör att våra lärare får mer tid till att dela sin kunskap, både med elever och kollegor. Vi har ett starkt elevhälsoteam som jobbar nära eleverna och lärarna. 

Tjänstebeskrivning

IES Skellefteå är en tvåspråkig skola där vi jobbar tillsammans, personal och elever, i en internationell miljö.  Du bör känna dig bekväm med att kommunicera i både tal och skrift med både elever, deras familjer och personal på engelska och svenska. Undervisningen på IES följer svensk läroplan och kursplaner. 

Vem är du?

- Du har lärarexamen med behörighet att undervisa SVA. 
- Du har kunskaper om och delar Internationella Engelska skolans värderingar och ethos*
- Du har erfarenhet från arbete i skolan.
- Du brinner för utveckling och ett kollegialt arbetssätt.

*För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/skelleftea/

Tjänsten börjar så snart som möjligt eller i början av vårterminen (11:e januari). Rekryteringen sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan (CV, personligt brev och lärarlegitimation) via vår IES Careers webbplats så snart som möjligt.

jobs.occupation: Early Years Class Assistant, International School of Helsingborg
jobs.employer_name: Helsingborgs kommun
jobs.description:
About us
The International School of Helsingborg has provided a truly international education at the Primary and Secondary levels since 1995. Today, we have approximately 650 students between 3 and 19 years of age, across all programmes. We are an IB Continuum school, delivering the International Baccalaureate curriculum for all program levels. English is the primary language of learning at the school.
ISH prides itself on its diversity within and among all members of the learning community. Every member of our learning community brings something exciting and enriching to the school, which creates an inspiring environment. The aim of our school is to develop internationally minded people who, recognising their common humanity and shared guardianship of the planet, help to create a better and more peaceful world.
Read more about the International School of Helsingborg on our website: https://internationalschool.helsingborg.se/
Job description
As an early years assistant, your role will be to organize and monitor activities for the students, ages 3-5 in the early years program. You will work with a team of early years teachers and will be expected to interact with the students in a caring manner. You will be expected to lead a group of students with positive behavior management techniques. You will be expected to work together in a team with the early years colleagues in order to plan engaging activities for the students. The hours vary on a daily basis approximately between 07:30 and 17:30 each day.
The position includes supporting students and teachers in the regular classroom during the school day in addition to after-school activities. We are looking for someone who works well in a team. You are positive, open minded and flexible. When working with the students, you are consistent and kind. You take the time to get to know the students and build relationships with them. You take initiative within organizing activities and helping to make early years a place students enjoy.
Qualifications
A degree or certificate within early years and/or in primary education is preferred.
The successful candidate will have at least two years’ experience working with groups of kids in the ages 3-5, including working with children with various support needs.
The primary language of the school is English. Therefore, it is critical and required that any candidates are able to read, write and speak in English fluently.
Priority will be given to candidates who are also fluent in Swedish.
Other information
Apply by:  December 7, 2026. We reserve the right to start the recruitment process earlier.
Terms of employment:  Tidsbegränsad anställning (Temporary position)
Scope:  100 %
Date:  January 25, 2027 - June 25, 2027
